artifact_counts.grain: deduplicated valid artifact row, not target case
artifact_counts.note: This audit does not infer replay generalization. Use the concrete replay migration report for exact PUT-to-basis pairing.
artifact_counts.scope: Artifact rows from current canonical subject directories.

case_counts.grain: target case (one of 509 canonical RQ1 targets)
case_counts.partition: valid_no_put_cases, put_no_r1r2_cases, and put_with_r1r2_cases are mutually exclusive and partition valid_cases.
case_counts.put_no_r1r2_cases: Cases with at least one valid PUT but no valid PUT carrying R1 or R2.
case_counts.put_with_r1r2_cases: Cases with at least one valid PUT carrying R1 or R2.
case_counts.valid_no_put_cases: Valid cases with zero valid PUT artifacts. This is a case count, not a concrete replay count.
